findings.body: The diff adds `MemoryPendingStore`, `PENDING_TTL_SECS`, `PendingAuthorization`, and `PendingAuthorizationStore` to the public re‑exports from the `registry` module. If those identifiers are not defined in `src/registry.rs` (or its submodule) the crate will fail to compile. Verify that these symbols exist and are public in the registry module before merging.
findings.title: Re-exported symbols might be undefined

value.summary: Pending store symbols are re-exported but may not exist in the registry module, potentially causing a compile error.
